auditBasis: Live https://certamaris.com and the static export audited 2026-10-22 through 2026-10-23. The 2026-10-21 audit confirmed broad responsive, target-size, navigation, search, footer, and trust-page quality; the 2026-10-22 empty-state pass closed the company empty-state cluster; the final SEO pass closed alias, sitemap, schema, and metadata integrity gaps.

defects.evidence: live og:image and twitter:image now https://certamaris.com/og/certamaris-link-preview-2026-10-v1.png (1200x630) after deploy 6646297d
defects.note: Commit c028095 was authored but not live; live still served certamaris-og.jpg. Deployed HEAD.

defects.evidence: Before: 8/9 header controls <44px (36-37px nav buttons, 23px logo). After: 0/9 desktop, 0/2 mobile under 44px (live readback after deploy 645e711a). Commit 99fd3a7.
defects.note: WCAG 2.5.8 AAA target size. Enforced min-height 44px on persistent header controls, mega dropdown links, mobile sub-links, footer links, and search trigger.

defects.evidence: qa:check-seo WARN (5): duplicate H1 'privacy policy', 'subprocessor list', 'business terms' across legal/* and legacy aliases; not-found title/H1 shared (404 vs _not-found).
defects.note: Intentional legacy alias routes pointing at the same logical content; titles already disambiguated where required. Documented expected warnings since 2026-09-27 IA remediation.

defects.evidence: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high remains red on 4 pre-existing advisories.
defects.note: No dependency changes introduced in this pass. Pre-existing; deferred to owner-approved dependency maintenance.

defects.target: /about/partners, /about/careers, /about/press; components/EmptyState.tsx; CommandPalette and Resources no-match states
defects.rootCause: Three route-specific copies of one minimal block provided no shared state primitive, insufficient visual differentiation, and no dedicated visual/regression gate.
defects.fix: Added the shared EmptyState page/compact system with distinct motifs, explicit unpublished status, one primary action, a three-step routing band, and four related paths per company route. Reused the compact variants for resources and command-search no-match states.
defects.verification: Dedicated before/after/live QA: 3 routes x 12 viewport-orientation checks, 72 screenshots per set, 0 overflow, 0 broken images, one H1, one primary action, three process steps, four related links, all state targets >=44px, 0 serious/critical axe findings. Live routes return 200. Worker version ffe4337d-8b08-4e4f-a837-0ed085b8ea5c at 100%.

defects.target: inline body-copy text links and small widgets across pages
defects.evidence: Homepage remaining <44px items are inline text links (16-22px, e.g. 'Full comparison on Why CertaMaris') and small widgets (32-39px step/tab/range controls).
defects.note: Inline links in a sentence are exempt from WCAG 2.5.8; small widgets already exceed the AA 24px floor. Full 44px body-wide remediation is a larger cross-component follow-up and was deferred to avoid visual churn against owner-approved design.

defects.evidence: Four legal meta descriptions exceeded 160 characters before remediation. Final check-meta-lengths.mjs: 105 pages, 0 descriptions over 160, 0 titles over 60.
defects.note: Legal document body text was not changed.

defects.evidence: Alias metadata now uses noindex,follow and canonicalizes to the maintained /legal/* route. Live un-followed readback returned 301 for each alias.
defects.note: Legacy URLs remain available for external links while consolidating canonical signals.

defects.evidence: Static fallbacks are noindex,follow and canonicalize to final destinations. Live un-followed readback: /industries -> /who-we-serve, /sample-platform -> /demo, /platform/corporate-control-plane -> /platform/client-company-portal.
defects.note: Worker and static-export behavior are aligned.

defects.evidence: Strict audit: 105 exported HTML pages, 95 indexable routes, 95 sitemap URLs, 0 hard errors, 0 warnings. Live sitemap: 95 URLs, includes /sitemap, excludes the /privacy alias.
defects.note: The human /sitemap page was added and redirect fallbacks were removed from indexable sitemap membership.

defects.target: compliance, glossary, resources, article, topic, and about templates
defects.evidence: Strict audit parsed all JSON-LD blocks and matched FAQ, article, breadcrumb, and person content against rendered text: 0 JSON-LD parse errors and 0 mismatches.
defects.note: Visible breadcrumbs were added to templates that publish BreadcrumbList schema.

defects.evidence: Rendered title is 'Maritime Cyber Compliance Software' (44 characters including the brand template) instead of the brand-only default.
defects.note: H1 and page content were not changed for this metadata fix.

defects.evidence: Leadership now uses the approved 1200x630 branded PNG social card; shared metadata infers image MIME and dimensions correctly.
defects.note: Root and route social-preview checks passed 14/14.

defects.evidence: Strict local and live full-sitemap gates are runnable and green; the final live visual crawl recorded 95 routes, 340 observations, and 0 failures.
defects.note: Coverage includes canonical collisions, sitemap/indexability parity, JSON-LD parsing and content matching, H1 count, overflow, image loading, and console/network failures.
